metadata.title: Capecitabine and Temozolomide Therapy
metadata.indication: Locally advanced or metastatic pancreatic neuroendocrine tumours.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Organ-function values or categories are optional; omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled · independent clinical and pharmacy review pending

organ_function_reconciliation.note: CAPTEM-specific renal/hepatic boundaries reconciled, with severe hepatic exclusion versus Table 2 and off-label750 mg/m² renal-start differences explicit. Independent clinical/pharmacy review pending.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Official oral catalogue00505a target and byte-identical source PDF checked; full source audit documented separately.
metadata.schedule_summary: Capecitabine 750 mg/m² twice daily on Days 1–14; temozolomide 200 mg/m² once daily on Days 10–14; neither on Days 15–28. Six 28-day cycles unless progression/unacceptable toxicity.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00505 Version 5. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.
clinical_governance.organ_function_rule_status: NCCP 00505v5 reconciled for v0.84.37 with source differences declared; independent consultant/pharmacy validation remains pending.

indications.description: Locally advanced or metastatic pancreatic neuroendocrine tumours.

treatment.schedule_summary: Capecitabine 750 mg/m² twice daily on Days 1–14; temozolomide 200 mg/m² once daily on Days 10–14; neither on Days 15–28. Six 28-day cycles unless progression/unacceptable toxicity.

hypersensitivity.label: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component

febrile_or_active_infection.label: Fever, febrile neutropenia or active infection requiring treatment

other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.label: Worst relevant non-haematological toxicity

options.label: Grade 0 — No toxicity
options.description: No other non-haematological adverse event.

options.label: Grade 1 — Mild
options.description: Grade 1 under the named CTCAE term: generally mild or asymptomatic, with observation only and no intervention indicated.

options.label: Grade 2 — Moderate
options.description: Grade 2 under the named CTCAE term: generally moderate; local/non-invasive intervention may be indicated and instrumental activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 3 — Severe
options.description: Grade 3 under the named CTCAE term: severe or medically significant; hospital care may be indicated and self-care activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 4 — Life-threatening
options.description: Grade 4 under the named CTCAE term: life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify the exact adverse event and use its toxicity-specific CTCAE definition; assess symptoms, intervention and functional impact before selecting the grade. NCCP Table 3 cites CTCAE 4; any generic CTCAE 5 descriptor is a UI aid, not an assertion that editions are interchangeable. Confirm the source grade clinically.

dpd_status.label: DPD status
dpd_status.assessment_guidance: DPD phenotype and/or genotype before first capecitabine unless previously tested. Renal impairment can falsely elevate uracil phenotyping; consider genotype testing. Complete deficiency excludes capecitabine. Partial deficiency needs an individualised lower starting dose; carefully monitored initial titration differs from re-escalation after toxicity.

diarrhoea_grade.label: Diarrhoea grade

options.label: Grade 0 — No toxicity
options.description: No diarrhoea above usual baseline.

options.label: Grade 1 — Mild
options.description: NCCP Table 4:2–3 more stools/day or nocturnal stools; source overlaps grade 2.

options.label: Grade 2 — Moderate
options.description: NCCP Table 4:4–6 more stools/day or nocturnal stools.

options.label: Grade 3 — Severe
options.description: NCCP Table 4:7–9 more stools/day or incontinence.

options.label: Grade 4 — Life-threatening
options.description: NCCP Table 4:10 or more additional stools/day or grossly bloody diarrhoea; parenteral support may be needed.

diarrhoea_grade.assessment_guidance: Grade using increase in stools over baseline, ostomy output, need for hospitalisation and impact on self-care; do not grade from the word “diarrhoea” alone. NCCP Table 3 cites CTCAE 4; any generic CTCAE 5 descriptor is a UI aid, not an assertion that editions are interchangeable. Confirm the source grade clinically.
diarrhoea_grade.source_grading_note: Source-specific legacy bands; nocturnal stools overlap grade 0–1 and 2 in the source. Confirm clinician-assessed grade; do not automatically infer it from stool count.

mucositis_grade.label: Oral mucositis/stomatitis grade

options.label: Grade 0 — No toxicity
options.description: No oral mucositis.

options.label: Grade 1 — Mild
options.description: Asymptomatic or mild symptoms; intervention not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2 — Moderate
options.description: Moderate pain or ulceration that does not interfere with oral intake; modified diet indicated.

options.label: Grade 3 — Severe
options.description: Severe pain that interferes with oral intake.

options.label: Grade 4 — Life-threatening
options.description: Life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

mucositis_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess pain, ulceration and whether oral intake is preserved, modified or impossible. NCCP Table 3 cites CTCAE 4; any generic CTCAE 5 descriptor is a UI aid, not an assertion that editions are interchangeable. Confirm the source grade clinically.

hand_foot_syndrome_grade.label: Palmar-plantar erythrodysaesthesia (hand-foot syndrome) grade

options.label: Grade 0 — No toxicity
options.description: No hand-foot syndrome.

options.label: Grade 1 — Mild
options.description: NCCP Table 5: skin changes/tingling/erythema with discomfort not disrupting normal activities.

options.label: Grade 2 — Moderate
options.description: NCCP Table 5: painful skin changes affecting daily activities.

options.label: Grade 3 — Severe
options.description: NCCP Table 5: severe skin changes including blistering/ulceration with pain and inability to work or perform daily activities.

hand_foot_syndrome_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess skin changes, pain and impact on instrumental or self-care activities of daily living.
hand_foot_syndrome_grade.source_grading_note: Grade2/3 interrupts until ≤ 1. Following grade 3, decrease the next capecitabine dose; Table 5 does not quantify the reduction. No invented percentage.

capecitabine_renal_band.label: Renal function for capecitabine
capecitabine_renal_band.assessment_guidance: NCCP 00505 Table 2:30–50 gives 75% of original dose;51–80 no adjustment;<30/haemodialysis not recommended. The 750 mg/m² CAPTEM starting dose is not the1250/1000 mg/m² renal examples in EMA Xeloda. Consultant/pharmacy reconciliation prevents an automatic extra reduction or re-escalation.

temozolomide_hepatic_band.label: Hepatic impairment for temozolomide
temozolomide_hepatic_band.assessment_guidance: Table 2: Child-PughA/B no adjustment; Child-PughC none expected. Severe hepatic impairment is nevertheless excluded for the combined CAPTEM regimen on p1. Specialist review, not automatic CAPTEM clearance.

assessment_type.label: Timing of this assessment

options.label: Before a subsequent dose/cycle or restarting after toxicity

assessment_type.assessment_guidance: NCCP distinguishes first-treatment counts (ANC 1.5/platelets 100 caution), unscheduled capecitabine interruption (ANC 1/platelets 75), and combination Table 1 recovery (ANC 1.5/platelets 75). No timing is inferred.

hbv_screen_missing.label: Baseline hepatitis B screening not completed

significant_liver_abnormality.label: Significant abnormal liver tests requiring temozolomide benefit/risk review

steroids_or_pjp_concern.label: Steroid exposure or concern about PJP risk

new_unexplained_respiratory_symptoms.label: New unexplained breathlessness/cough or suspected opportunistic infection

current_chest_pain.label: Current chest pain / possible treatment cardiotoxicity

interaction_review_needed.label: Potential clinically important medicine interaction requires review

treatment_related_liver_abnormality.label: Liver abnormality assessed as treatment related

hepatic_impairment_severity.label: Overall hepatic impairment severity
hepatic_impairment_severity.assessment_guidance: NCCP p1 severe hepatic impairment is an exclusion, despite Table 2 no routine hepatic adjustment. Do not interpret the Table 2 temozolomide Child-PughC row as authorising CAPTEM in severe hepatic impairment.

crcl_ml_min.label: Measured/calculated creatinine clearance
crcl_ml_min.assessment_guidance: Use the protocol CrCl measure, not an unexamined eGFR substitution. Table 2 has an uncovered decimal interval >50 and <51; do not round it automatically.

capecitabine_previous_dose_percent.label: Most recent capecitabine dose (% of documented starting prescription)
capecitabine_previous_dose_percent.assessment_guidance: Include all prior reductions before this interruption. Unknown or lower previous dose prevents an automatic numeric increase; no stacking percentages. Initial partial-DPD titration is a separately supervised exception.

temozolomide_previous_dose_percent.label: Most recent temozolomide dose (% of documented starting prescription)
temozolomide_previous_dose_percent.assessment_guidance: Include all prior reductions before this interruption. Unknown or lower previous dose prevents an automatic numeric increase; no stacking percentages. Initial partial-DPD titration is a separately supervised exception.

lowest_anc_episode.label: Lowest ANC in the same toxicity episode
lowest_anc_episode.assessment_guidance: Document BOTH episode nadirs. Table 1 applies to both CAPTEM components, using the worst band and episode recurrence. It does not specify the percentage-dose denominator, so recovered targets require consultant/pharmacy confirmation.

lowest_platelets_episode.label: Lowest platelets in the same toxicity episode
lowest_platelets_episode.assessment_guidance: Document BOTH episode nadirs. Table 1 applies to both CAPTEM components, using the worst band and episode recurrence. It does not specify the percentage-dose denominator, so recovered targets require consultant/pharmacy confirmation.

haematology_occurrence.label: Occurrence of the same haematological toxicity
haematology_occurrence.assessment_guidance: Count the documented recurrent episode; do not infer first occurrence.

output_templates.proceed: No encoded restriction was triggered in the entered domain(s). This is not an overall treatment clearance.

rule_engine.conflict_policy: Use the most restrictive action for each component; do not multiply reductions. Component findings do not authorise unaffected drugs.
rule_engine.missing_data_policy: Only supplied values assessed; never infer timing, nadirs, recurrence, recovery or previous dose.

action.recommendation: ECOG 0–1 is the CAPTEM eligibility range; ECOG  ≥ 2 requires consultant review. Do not inherit ECOG 0–2 from capecitabine monotherapy.

rules.explanation: ECOG 0–1 is the CAPTEM eligibility range; ECOG  ≥ 2 requires consultant review. Do not inherit ECOG 0–2 from capecitabine monotherapy.

action.recommendation: Known hypersensitivity to a CAPTEM component/excipient is an exclusion; clarify which drug is affected before considering an alternative plan.

rules.explanation: Known hypersensitivity to a CAPTEM component/excipient is an exclusion; clarify which drug is affected before considering an alternative plan.

action.recommendation: Dacarbazine hypersensitivity contraindicates temozolomide.

action.recommendation: Pregnancy or breastfeeding is excluded by NCCP 00505.

action.recommendation: Recent or concomitant brivudine is excluded; do not administer capecitabine. Pharmacy must confirm an adequate washout under the current product information.

action.recommendation: Consider an individualised reduced capecitabine starting dose; no universal percentage is specified. Subsequent carefully monitored titration for initial partial-DPD dosing differs from re-escalation after toxicity.

action.recommendation: Urgent clinical assessment of fever/febrile neutropenia or active infection; withhold systemic treatment pending assessment. This is a conservative safety escalation, not a numeric NCCP dose reduction.

action.recommendation: NCCP advises caution when starting capecitabine with ANC<1.5 or platelets<100; EMA Xeloda SmPC 4.2 says not to treat. Resolve that source difference with consultant/pharmacy before initiation. Table 1 platelet recovery ≥ 75 does not establish baseline eligibility.

action.recommendation: Confirm baseline, subsequent-dose or unscheduled within-cycle timing before interpreting these counts. Missing timing does not select a more permissive threshold.

action.recommendation: Unscheduled within-cycle ANC<1 or platelets<75: interrupt capecitabine. Review the complete CAPTEM plan; this component-specific finding does not authorise temozolomide.

action.recommendation: Delay both CAPTEM components until ANC ≥ 1.5 AND platelets ≥ 75; determine the worst episode count band, recurrence and previous component doses before restart.

eligibility: Locally advanced or metastatic pancreatic neuroendocrine tumours (00505a).
Off-label indication in Ireland: documented discussion/consent and hospitalpolicy requirements apply.
exclusions: Component/excipient hypersensitivity; dacarbazine hypersensitivity contraindicates temozolomide.
Complete DPD deficiency or severe unexpected fluoropyrimidine reaction history.
Pregnancy/breastfeeding; severe marrow suppression; severe hepatic or renal impairment (baseline CrCl<30).
monitoring: Baseline: FBC, renal/liver profile; HBsAg AND HBcoreAb; DPD before first capecitabine unless previously tested; INR if warfarin as clinically indicated.
Before EACH cycle: FBC, renal/liver profile; INR if warfarin as clinically indicated.
Liver tests AFTER EACH cycle because of temozolomide; hepatotoxicity may appearweeks after the final dose.
Disease imaging/markers follow the consultant plan; no fixed universal imaging/tumour-marker cadence is specified.
Assess toxicity, hydration, infection/PJP and cardiac symptoms; PJP prophylaxis follows local policy.
dose_modifications: All dose modifications require consultant discussion.
NCCP 00505 Table 1 applies to BOTH components; recovery ANC ≥ 1.5 AND platelets ≥ 75. Baseline capecitabine caution isANC<1.5/platelets<100. These are not interchangeable.
Tables3–6 apply to CAPECITABINE; do not automatically apply them to temozolomide.
Previous toxicity reductions are not re-escalated; omitted capecitabine toxicity doses are not replaced. Initial partial DPD titration is separate.

Table 1 percentage denominator, renal750 mg/m² start source differences, severe first-event choices, liver source ambiguity, rounded table gaps and unspecified HFS reductions require specialist review rather than invented numeric dosing.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Capecitabine minimal–low Days 1–14; temozolomide moderate–high Days 10–14. Oral local policy plan, not parenteral low-risk coverage.
supportive_care.pjp_prophylaxis: Assess under local policy; not a universal 42-day RT prophylaxis instruction.
supportive_care.premedications: None usually required; separate prescribed antiemetic plan remains necessary.

treatment_phases.label: CAPTEM 28-day cycle

administration.notes: With food or within 30 minutes of eating; whole tablets, no crushing/cutting; pharmacy dose banding.
Fasting; swallow capsules whole. After vomiting do not repeat the dose that day.

treatment_phases.notes: Days 1–9 capecitabine only; Days 10–14 both drugs at their different food timings; Days 15–28 rest from both. Prescribed timing/capsule combinations and supportive plan require pharmacy confirmation.
